name: Aimed Blow
description: Special Attack. +2 Precision /rank. Costs 1 action that does not count towards the combat roll. Total Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Akimbo
description: You may use the better combat roll for both hands, unless that roll has higher bonuses. Affects Margin Of Victory.

name: Anti-Armored Combat: Blunt
description: Bypass 1 Armor/rank, also makes breeches easier.

name: Armor Piercing
description: You bypass 0.5 Armor/Margin of Victory with piercing melee weapons.

name: Armored Combat
description: Reduce the total Evasion Penalty from Armor by 1/rank.

name: Blind Fighting
description: Reduces the expertise penalty for blindness or invisible opponents from -15 to -4.

name: Blow Deflection
description: Learn to deflect some of the force of  blows on your plate armor or metal helm. +1  AR /rank.

name: Breeching Blows
description: Increase your Breaches with all blunt weapons by 1.

name: Combat Intensity
description: +1 Expertise /action spent.

name: Committed Strikes
description:
Your Damage bonus is doubled when you wield the following weapons with two hands:
Bastard Sword, Great Sword, Battle Axe, Great Axe, Warhammer, Maul, Morning Star, Spear, or Pike.

name: Counter Strike
description: If you lose combat you may attempt an Awareness Check 25 to hit back for half damage after their damage roll.

name: Diligent Defence
description: You are immune to flanking.

name: Disarm
description: Disarm an opponent instead of rolling damage after winning the combat roll, unless they roll an Awareness Check that is more than triple the margin of victory.

name: Dual Wielding
description: Allows you to attack with two weapons, each action applying fully to both combat rolls.

name: Dueling
description: When wielding a 1-handed weapon which is quick or light, while Unfettered with the off hand free: +1 expertise and +1 Precision /rank. Total Precision can never exceed 25

name: Expert Shielding
description: Increase your Evasion when using a shield by 1 /rank. Total Evasion can never exceed 20.

name: Feint
description: Attempt to fool your melee opponent into blocking the wrong thing. Declare before rolling combat. +5 Precision, -5 Evasion. Total Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Follow Through
description: If you sever a limb you may make a Dexterity Check 20. If you sever a leg deal ½ damage to the other leg as well. If you sever an arm, deal ½ damage to the torso. Armor Rating applies in both cases.

name: Formation Charging
description: Allows you to reap the benefits of formation fighting even when moving at full speed.

name: Formation Fighting
description: .=+1 Expertise for each flank of yours covered by a person who also has this skill/rank.

name: Give Ground
description: Can counter reckless attacks by backing up carefully. Enter a combat mode in which you are not affected by reckless attacks, and may not make attacks of opportunity. You must retreat at least 4 Feet for each reckless attack and your damage is reduced by 25%.

name: Hard Hitting
description: Add your damage bonus to your expertise. Does not stack with committed strikes. (your damage bonus as shown on the strength row of the main page is added to your expertise. It is not doubled for this purpose even if you have committed strikes and use a suitable weapon.)

name: Heavy Blow
prereq:
Special Attack,
 can not be a quick or light weapon.
description: Special Attack. +1 damage/rank. Costs 1 action that does not count towards the combat roll.

name: Interdict
description: Declare at the end of your movement phase. Costs 1 action which does not count towards the combat roll.  You may move up to 10 Feet just before the combat phase, without passing through hostile creatures and ending in unoccupied space. No attacks of opportunity are triggered. At the end of the movement you may taunt any hostils in reach and enter combat with all who fail the check, or one if all pass the check. If you were already in combat when your initiative turn came up, your opponents may follow your move, space permitting.

name: Killer Instinct
description: Your Attacks of Opportunity have a Margin of Victory of 6

name: Knock Back
description: Special Attack which Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. Your target is knocked back 1 Foot/Margin of Victory, up to a maximum of 10 Feet. This is modified by the relative size of the target.

name: Leap Attack
description: Move at least 10 Feet and make a reckless attack which costs 1 action which does not count towards the combat roll. Apply 1 damage roll with your damage bonus added 1 extra time to any target in range. May cause fear at the GM's discretion. Damage in the combat round in not increased. Note that reckless attacks occur at the end of the movement phase. Reckless attacks have no location control.

name: Melee Mastery
description: .=+1 Expertise in melee combat/rank.

name: Mounted Combat
description: Gain +1 expertise  and +1 damage while mounted /rank. This bonus is doubled when charging.

name: Offensive Shielding
description: +1 Expertise /rank with a shield equipped.

name: Opportunistic
description: Make a free damage roll on any opponent who tries to move past you without engaging you, turns away to flee, or becomes prone or stunned within reach. The Margin of Victory is zero.

name: Parry
description: Permanent passive melee ability: Add your active precision to your evasion. Total Evasion can never exceed 20. Cannot be used with Awkward weapons.

name: Phalanx
description: Use a long weapon to attack from behind an ally. This costs 1 action which does not count towards the combat roll. Cannot be used on reckless attacks.

name: Precise Strikes
description: +1 Precision  /rank. Total Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Punishing Blows
description: Increase your damage bonus with all weapons by +1 /rank. Note that some weapons do not benefit from damage bonus.

name: Reckless Rage
description: Enter a battle trance in which all fear and caution is abandoned for pure ferocity. Ending the rage requires that all enemies be vanquished or a Willpower Check 25. At the end of your movement phase you may roll damage on one target in range or make another reckless attack.(e.g. Leap attack, Sweep) Melee damage you take during the combat phase is doubled. For the duration of the rage you are exposed to attacks of opportunity, resolved after movement, (one per turn per opponent), and your Rear Evasion is used. Reckless attacks have a Margin of Victory of zero.

name: Rend Armor
description: Your Armor Breaches are doubled.

name: Riposte
prereq:
Serpent Mark
Quick or light weapons only
description: If you lose combat you may attempt a Dexterity Check 26 to hit back after their damage roll.

name: Ruthless Tempo
description:
Improve your chance to roll a critical with melee attacks. Below is the total natural roll needed depending on the combat die type and Ruthless Tempo rank.
Rank               D12's           D10's        D8's        D6's      
   0                     23               20             16           12         
   1                     22               19             16           12
   2                     21               18             15           11
   3                     20               17             14           11
   4                     19               16             13           10

name: Savage
description: Melee Critical hits add the damage bonus as well.

name: Shield Breaker
description: Special attack. Attack with Precision 0 and do double damage to Shields.

name: Shield Deflection
description: Learn to deflect some of the force of  blows on your shield, incresing its durability. +1 Shield AR /rank.

name: Shield Punch
description: Costs 1 action. Make a surprise attack with the edge of the shield at the end of your movement phase. Unless your target passes an Awareness Check 25. 1d6 +damage bonus.

name: Shield Rush
description: Special Attack which Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. Your target is knocked back 1 Foot/Margin of Victory, up to a maximum of 10 Feet. This is modified by the relative size and weight of the target.

name: Shield Wall
description: A group of 4 or more people with this skill can form an effective shield wall which gives 100% coverage to all ranged and melee attacks within 160 degree arc which do not breach a shield. Those maintaining the wall cannot roll damage.

name: Sweep
description: Reckless attack which costs 1 action that does not count towards combat. Apply one damage roll to two targets in range, Dex Check 25 for half damage.  The targets must be within a 90 degree arc and cannot be separated by another creature or solid thing. Note that reckless attacks occur at the end of the movement phase.

name: Sweeping Blow
description: Special Melee Attack which costs 1 action that does not count towards combat. Apply one damage roll to two targets in range, Dex Check 25 for half damage.  The targets must be within a 90 degree arc and cannot be separated by another creature or solid thing.

name: Subdue Opponent
description: Pass a Strength Check to take the fight to the ground instead of doing damage after winning the combat roll. Not always possible especially on larger opponents.

name: Taunt
description: Force an enemy within 10 Feet to attack you, joining your combat and rolling its damage against you if any. The taunt is resisted on a Willpower Check of 22. Several skills such as Acting, Monster Lore and others can make the taunt harder to resist if a skill check is passed. Some skills can be used in combination.

name: The Art of War
description: Enter and leave combat without cost, penalty or attacks of opportunity. Cannot be performed while reckless.

name: Tie Breaker
description: You win tied combat rolls with a Margin of Vistory of 1.

name: Twist the blade
description: Your get full damage bonus with Daggers and half damage bonus with Rapiers.

name: Victorious Damage
description: Exploit your Margin of Victory more fully.  +0.1 Damage/Margin of Victory/Rank up to a maximum of +15 .

name: Victorious Precision
description: Use your mastery of combat to control where openings occur. +0.1 Precision /Margin of Victory/Rank. Cannot be used with awkward weapons. Total Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Wardancing
description: +1 Expertise/Rank when dual wielding or unarmed.

name: Weapon Mark Fox
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +1 Expertise with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Weapon Mark Serpent
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +2 Precision with the chosen weapon type(s). Total Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Weapon Mark Tiger
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +1 Expertise and +1 Damage with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Weapon Mark Heron
prereq:
Melee Mastery 10
Only Long Sword, Short sword, Dagger,Rapier , Staff or Unarmed
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +3 Expertise and +3 Precision with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Increase your maximum skill in Melee Mastery, Throwing Mastery, Crossbow Mastery and Archery by 2.

name: Well Trained
description: +1 Precision and +1 Expertise with all melee weapons /rank.

name: Whirling Dervish
prereq:
Reckless Rage
Dual wielding only
Well Trained 3
description: Reckless attack which costs 1 action that does not count towards combat. Roll damage on each creature (friend or foe) within 10 Feet, without any Location Control.  Note that Reckless Attacks occur at the end of the movement phase.

name: Whirlwind
description: Reckless attack which costs 1 action that does not count towards combat. Apply one damage roll to all creatures (friend or foe) within 10 Feet, Dex Check 25 for half damage. In the combat phase proceed as normal for reckless attacks but you may not roll damage. Note that reckless attacks occur at the end of the movement phase.

name: Wind Wielder
description: When wielding a Staff or Spear with Fox Mark in two hands, while Unfettered: +1 expertise /rank.

name: A Leaf on the Wind
description: Your Rear Evasion is never used. Your normal Evasion is used instead.

name: Alacrity
description: +1 Foot /action movement /rank.

name: Backstab
description: When hitting from Behind you gain 2 CRITs instead of 1.

name: Blind
description: Throw sand or powder at the eyes of a target within 6 Feet. Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. You must have sand or powder within easy reach or previously stashed in a pocket. Target must pass a Dexterity check 22 or be blinded for 1d4 rounds.

name: Cascading Strikes
description: Learn to press any advantage in combat with further blows, exposing and exploiting weaknesses. +0.1 Precision and 0.1 Damage/Margin of Victory/rank with unarmed blows. Total Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Erratic Motion
description: Costs 1 action which does not count towards combat. -5 Penalty to all ranged to hit rolls targeting you.

name: Kick
description: Special move. Costs one action which does not count towards combat. Make a surprise kick at the end of your movement phase unless the Target  passes an Awareness check 25. Damage is 1d4 +damage bonus instead of your normal weapon damage. Not a reckless attack.

name: Leverage
description: Any unarmed attack in which any combat die rolled a natural 12 is a critical.

name: Martial Artist
description: When fighting unarmed you use d12 instead of d10 for combat and d4 instead of d3 for damage, and you may use the better combat roll for both hands

name: Martial Marking
description: Allows melee weapon marks to be applied to your fists through tattoos. All benefits apply.

name: Methodical Madness
description: Gain +4 on all single action Combat Rolls. (This includes rolls when you have no actions available.)

name: Mindful Motion
description: Gain Advantage on all Dexterity checks.

name: Evasive Motion
description: +1 Evasion /rank. Total Evasion can never exceed 20.

name: On your Toes
description: You may move an extra 5 Feet during your first action only in any melee round.

name: Roll with the Punches
description: +1 Armor Rating /rank

name: Sudden Strike
prereq:
Unfettered and
Piercing Weapons with
Serpent Mark
or Unarmed.
description: Start a combat with a deceptively fast sucker punch. Special move. Costs one action which does not count towards combat. Make a surprise strike at the end of your movement phase unless the Target passes an Awareness Check 25. Not a reckless attack.

name: The Willow Bends
description: Can counter reckless attacks through fluid avoidance. Enter a combat mode in which you are not affected by reckless attacks, and may not make attacks of opportunity. Your damage is reduced by 25%. Note that this skill makes the "give ground" skill redundant

name: Vigilance
description: All ranged attacks that target you suffer -1 to hit/rank.

name: Wall Jump
description: You can wall jump to double your normal vertical jump.

name: Aimed Shot
description: You may save at least two actions from this turn to be added to a single special shot next turn. The aimed shot keeps the best three dice instead of two. A crit requires all three dice be 10s, but very large Hit Surpluses are possible. The aimed shot may not exceed 8 actions.

name: Anti Armor Archery
description: You  bypass 0.25 armor/Hit Surplus with piercing ranged weapons/rank

name: Archery
description: .+1 to hit with all bows/rank. This also limits what types of bow you can use.

name: Crossbow Mastery
description: .+1 to hit with all crossbows/rank.

name: Heave and Cleave
description: when you throw weapons your melee armor piercing and damage bonuses apply instead of your ranged ones. Hit Surplus is used for MoV.

name: Hurling
description: Doubles the range of thrown weapons.

name: Killer Aim
description: You gain +0.34 Damage/rank for each point of Hit Surplus, round down./rank

name: Lethal Precision
description: You gain +0.5 Ranged Precision/rank for each point of Hit Surplus/rank. Total Ranged Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Melee Momentum
description: Any actions you spend throwing a weapon do count towards combat with the target. (Like moving into combat.)

name: Mounted Marksman
description: Reduces the penalty for being mounted on  ranged attacks by 1.

name: Overdraw
description: Risk damaging your bow to do more damage. +1 Damage/Hit Surplus. If the final hit roll dice include a 7 the bowstring snaps or stretches. If it includes two 7s the bow cracks.

name: Precise Shots
description: Increase your Ranged Precision +/- 1/rank. Total Ranged Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Punishing Shots
description: Deal 1 extra damage on every bow or crossbow shot/rank.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Shoot with one action, (1 die) with +1 to hit/rank.

name: Target Practice
description: .+1 to hit and Precision with all ranged attacks /rank. Total Ranged Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Targeting: Combat
description: Reduce the penalty for shooting into combat by 1/rank (default penalty is 3 to hit.)

name: Targeting: Cover
description: Reduce the penalty for shooting into cover by 1/rank (default penalty is 1-4 to hit.)

name: Targeting: Long Range
description: Reduce the long range penalty from by 1/rank. (default penalty is 6 to hit.)

name: Targeting: Medium Range
description: Reduce the medium range penalty by 1/rank (default penalty is 3 to hit.)

name: Targeting: Motion
description: Reduce the penalty for moving targets by 1/rank (default penalty is 2-5 to hit.)

name: Targeting: Obstructed
description: Reduce the penalty for shooting past a creature or obstruction by 1/rank (default penalty is 1-3 to hit.)

name: Throwing Mastery
description: .+1 to hit with all thrown weapons /rank.

name: Very Long Range
description: Add a fourth range category: Very Long range with double your net long range penalty, and all Precision penalties are doubled.

name: Weapon Mark Sparrow
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +1 to hit with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Weapon Mark Falcon
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +1 Damage with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Weapon Mark Raven
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +2 Precision with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Weapon Mark Eagle
description: Specialize in one specific weapon type/rank. Gain +1 to hit and +1 Precision and +1 Damage with the chosen weapon type(s).

name: Zero-in
description: penalties are reduced by 1 when making a ranged attack at the same spot as your previous shot. This bonus is cumulative up to a total of -6. The effect is lost after 10 seconds, but renewed with each ranged attack. The minimum penalty is 0

name: Sky Shot
description: Fire high into the air to bring your projectile down on your target from above. This has 2 effects. 1: The range category is increased by one, and therefore this cannot be attempted on targets in your longest range category. 2: Your Ranged Precision is increased bv 10. Ranged Precision can never exceed 25.

name: Bellowing
description: Learn to control and project your voice to make it heard more widely and clearly. Doubles your leadership skill ranges.

name: Bodyguard
description: You can always be included in the same combat as an ally you are adjacent to.

name: Cry Havoc
description:
Rank 1: Charisma Check 25 to give 1 free action to all allies within 75 feet this melee round. These actions can only be used in combat, and moving into combat.
Can be used once per battle. Costs you 1 action which does not count towards combat.

name: Envelopment
description: Allies who accept your leadership who are within 50 Feet qualify as flanking or surrounding more easily. (The  largest open arc size allowed is increased from from 120 degrees to 180 degrees for surrounding and from 180 degrees to 210 degrees for flanking. This is the GM's problem to remember and track.)

name: Lead from the Front
description: Add 10% of your combat roll (round down) to all allies within 50 Feet who accept your leadership. (affects Margin of Victory)

name: Paragon
description: .+1/Rank on any Willpower Checks by you and your allies within 50 Feet.

name: Rousing Cry
description: Grants advantage on any Willpower Check given by your Rally Cry.

name: Rally Cry
description: Allows any allies suffering from the effects of any failed Willpower Check who hear the cry to immediately check again with your Paragon bonus. Costs 1 borrowed action. Normally 75 feet range.

name: Tactical Control
description:
Decide all melee participants within 50 Feet with the following conditions:
1: Each melee must include at least two opposing participants.
2: Each combatant must be included in a melee.
3: Bodyguards must be in the same melee as the adjacent ally they choose.
You may also decide the order combats are resolved in.  Note: Some opponent skills may interfere with this ability, and allies that do not accept your leadership may mess up your plan.

name: Tactical Teamwork
description: All allies who accept your Leadership within 50 Feet may use the best combat roll within their combat by each other or you. This does affect their Margin of Victory.
